data.probe: A zero wait is not a zero READ: wait-s 0's contract is answer-after-one-status-read; that read's own default cap (30s, the module _TIMEOUT_S) is the answer promise. A hung 0-read comes back 'list could not be read (timed out)', never live; a slow-but-successful read that says queued IS the truthful poll-once verdict, which is the zero-wait's entire promise.
data.title: ddflow/services/roborev.py:wait_job
